50642939.summary_en: A developer used the interactive theorem prover Lean 4 alongside differential testing methods to formally verify Clojure's core data structures and bitwise operations. The study uncovered 17 unreported bugs that were not in official JIRA or community records, including an infinite loop when running reduce on vector-of and hash collision node defects in HAMT.

comments.summary_zh: 列出的問題中有兩點值得商榷：第一點是向位元組陣列傳入長整數型別參數本就型別不合，第二點則是弱型別語言中強制型別轉換的預期行為；這類形式化驗證如果能釐清語言本身的動態語意標準，將能減少雜訊並發揮更大效益。
過去在 Common Lisp 編譯器稽核計畫中，也曾在 SBCL、Clozure 和 ACL2 裡發現數十個未通報的錯誤與問題。
原以為程式正確性驗證領域主流仍是 Rocq（前身為 Coq），好奇現在是否轉向了 Lean 4，以及語言模型在撰寫 Lean 程式碼的能力上是否明顯優於 Rocq。

50643065.title: Rumors swirling that labs might have cracked Factoring in P
50643065.title_zh: 傳聞有實驗室可能已破解多項式時間內的質因數分解難題
50643065.summary_zh: 網路社群盛傳某些頂尖人工智慧實驗室在密碼學與數學難題上取得重大突破。（無法取得原文內容，僅依標題判斷）
50643065.summary_en: There are swirling rumors in the online community that certain top AI labs have made a major breakthrough in cryptography and mathematical hard problems. (Content unavailable, judged by title alone)

comments.summary_zh: 這類多手傳聞未經證實且在密碼學界屢見不鮮，若 RSA 演算法真被攻破，國家情報機構勢必早已知情並進行管制，建議在轉傳前先等待一週觀察是否有權威消息證實。
若在多項式時間內完成質因數分解（Factoring in P）已被攻克且超出國家層級掌握，美國政府很可能會援引《國防生產法》接管人工智慧實驗室的運算資源，這也可能促使企業選擇盡可能隱瞞消息。
消息發布者後續澄清表示，雖然多個可靠消息來源顯示實驗室握有重大突破，但在看到技術細節或直接確認前，無法保證具體內容的精確性，避免以訛傳訛傳播未經證實的謠言。

50628600.title: A Clock Made of Branches
50628600.summary_zh: 探討在確定性虛擬機器（deterministic VM）中如何透過條件分支來計算時間，以確保程式重新執行時的時間一致性。文章分析了主機實體時脈的不穩定性，並說明透過計算指令流中的條件分支數量來作為計時機制的優勢與實作原理。
50628600.summary_en: Explores how to measure time using conditional branches in a deterministic virtual machine to ensure temporal consistency upon program replay. The article analyzes the instability of host wall-clock time and explains the advantages and implementation principles of using the count of conditional branches in the instruction stream as a timing mechanism.

comments.summary_zh: 文章標題極具畫面感，文中「1 秒運算且無出口」對應到虛擬時間 0 微秒的圖示，生動展現出內部不斷運行但外部宛如時間凝結的維度幽閉感，也令人聯想到科幻小說《死者代言人》中人工智慧的時間感知差距。
原本單純以為這篇文章要介紹的是用真實樹枝製作而成的實體時鐘。

50644817.title: 1Password Security Incident
50644817.summary_zh: 密碼管理器 1Password 發布資安事件報告，指出攻擊者入侵員工的 GitHub 帳號並存取後端系統，導致部分使用者的姓名、電子郵件及帳號元資料洩漏。官方強調使用者的密碼庫與金鑰完全未受影響，目前已更換所有可能暴露的內部憑證，並將邀請與恢復帳號的驗證碼長度擴增至 10 位數。
50644817.summary_en: Password manager 1Password released a security incident report stating that an attacker breached an employee's GitHub account and accessed backend systems, leading to the leak of names, email addresses, and account metadata for a subset of users. The company emphasized that customer vaults and secret keys were completely unaffected, all potentially exposed internal credentials have been rotated, and invitation and recovery tokens have been lengthened to 10 characters.

50644814.title: Deriving Black-Scholes
50644814.title_zh: 布萊克-休斯選擇權定價公式推導教學
50644814.summary_zh: 詳細推導金融領域著名的布萊克-休斯模型（Black-Scholes model），說明選擇權價格如何獨立於標的資產的漲跌趨勢。作者利用無套利假設（no-arbitrage hypothesis）建構出結合股票與選擇權的對沖組合，並透過泰勒展開式消去隨機波動項，最終匯出偏微分方程並求得選擇權定價。
50644814.summary_en: This post detailedly derives the renowned Black-Scholes model in finance, explaining how option prices are independent of whether the underlying asset trends up or down. By applying the no-arbitrage hypothesis to construct a delta-hedged portfolio and using Taylor expansion to eliminate random noise, the author successfully formulates the partial differential equation to solve for the option price.

50645074.title: Britain's ghost stations
50645074.title_zh: 英國鐵路中的幽靈車站奇觀
50645074.summary_zh: 介紹英國許多年載客人數極低的「幽靈車站（ghost stations）」，這些車站每年僅有數十至數百人次造訪。部分車站源於過去政府為避免繁瑣關閉程序而僅維持最低班次運作，另一類則位於幾乎無人居住的偏遠地區，近年更吸引許多鐵道迷前往朝聖。
50645074.summary_en: This article explores Britain's "ghost stations," which record extremely low annual passenger counts ranging from dozens to a few hundred. Some of these stations exist because operators reduced services to a minimum to avoid costly closure procedures, while others sit in nearly uninhabited remote areas, recently attracting railway enthusiasts embarking on pilgrimage visits.

50643199.title: In C++, = default and {} are not the same constructor
50643199.title_zh: 在 C++ 中，= default 與 {} 並非相同的建構子
50643199.summary_zh: 本文深入探討 C++ 程式語言中預設建構子宣告方式的差異與底層行為。（無法取得原文內容，僅依標題判斷）
50643199.summary_en: This article delves into the differences and underlying behaviors of default constructor declarations in the C++ programming language. (Content unavailable, judged by title alone)

50639929.title: The industrialization of noise: Automated proof-solving is the same old dead end [pdf]
50639929.title_zh: 雜訊的工業化：自動化定理證明只是老掉牙的死胡同
50639929.summary_zh: 本文探討人工智慧自動產出的大量數學證明，認為機械式解題脫離了人類社會化的批判過程，只會對數學生態系造成知識污染。當程式碼與無人審查的手稿淹沒文獻時，將導致有限的人力注意力在過濾信號與雜訊的競賽中落敗。
50639929.summary_en: This paper examines the massive volume of automated mathematical proofs generated by artificial intelligence, arguing that mechanical problem-solving is disconnected from the human social critique process and merely pollutes the mathematical ecosystem with knowledge. As unvetted manuscripts flood the literature, the finite supply of human attention is guaranteed to lose the race to separate signal from noise.

50637448.title: How did pinwheel calculators work?
50637448.title_zh: 滾輪式計算機是如何運作的？
50637448.summary_zh: 本文透過收藏的古董機械計算機展示四則運算的實際操作，並拆解其精密的內部機械結構。透過可變動的輻射狀插梢與進位齒輪，這些機械裝置能夠巧妙地完成加減乘除。
50637448.summary_en: This article demonstrates the practical operation of four-function calculations using a vintage mechanical calculator from a personal collection and disassembles its intricate internal mechanism. Through adjustable radial pins and carry gears, these mechanical devices can ingeniously perform addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

50627625.title: Show HN: Ribbon Architect – Endless ways to tie a gift ribbon
50627625.title_zh: Show HN：Ribbon Architect 提供豐富多樣的禮品緞帶綁法
50627625.summary_zh: 這是一個展示各種創意禮品緞帶打結方式的互動網頁工具。（無法取得原文內容，僅依標題判斷）
50627625.summary_en: This is an interactive web tool showcasing various creative ways to tie gift ribbons. (Content unavailable, judged by title alone)

50646108.title: Holy shit holy shit holy shit holy shit: The magnitude of what’s now happening
50646108.title_zh: 我的老天爺啊：當前正在發生的大規模變革
50646108.summary_zh: 人工智慧（AI）模型近期展現出驚人的數學證明能力，不僅解決了困擾演算法界數十年的矩陣乘法極限與快速傅立葉轉換難題，更讓人們預見通往 P 對 NP 問題（P versus NP problem）解答的曙光。這種變革就像是科學史上顯微鏡與望遠鏡的發明，正在為我們揭開前所未見的數學真理世界。
50646108.summary_en: Artificial intelligence models have recently demonstrated astonishing mathematical proving capabilities, solving decades-old algorithmic problems such as matrix multiplication limits and the Fast Fourier Transform, while shedding light on the P versus NP problem. This transformation resembles the historical invention of microscopes and telescopes, revealing an unprecedented world of mathematical truths to us.

50589784.title: SSH is a GUI framework
50589784.title_zh: SSH 竟然是個圖形使用者介面框架
50589784.summary_zh: SSH 長久以來被當作遠端連線工具，但它其實是一個多工、加密的位元串流，能在現今所有裝置的跨平台渲染引擎上運行。作者透過最新的終端機通訊協定，成功在 SSH 上原生渲染出完整的桌面環境與應用程式。
50589784.summary_en: SSH has long been regarded as a remote connection tool, but it is actually a multiplexed, encrypted byte stream that can run on cross-platform rendering engines across all modern devices. The author successfully renders a complete desktop environment and applications natively over SSH by leveraging the latest terminal protocols.

50644980.title: The polynomial Hirsch conjecture is false [pdf]
50644980.title_zh: 多項式赫許猜想是錯誤的
50644980.summary_zh: 這篇研究論文指出多項式赫許猜想在數學上並不成立。（無法取得原文內容，僅依標題判斷）
50644980.summary_en: This research paper demonstrates that the polynomial Hirsch conjecture is mathematically false. (Unable to retrieve original content, judged by title only)

50601280.title: GPT-6.2 Astra is the first model to beat Googlers' code golf records
50601280.title_zh: GPT-6.2 Astra 成為首個打破 Google工程師程式高爾夫紀錄的模型
50601280.summary_zh: 這項基準測試比較了當前頂尖人工智慧模型與 Google 工程師在 2015 年創下的程式高爾夫（code golf）紀錄。在限制 30 分鐘且僅能透過測試驗證的情況下，GPT-6.2 Astra 成功寫出比人類更短的程式碼，刷新了多項紀錄。
50601280.summary_en: This benchmark compares current frontier artificial intelligence models with the code golf records set by Google engineers in 2015. Given a 30-minute limit and verification solely through tests, GPT-6.2 Astra successfully wrote shorter code than humans, breaking multiple records.

50646662.title: Spending 35B Opus 5.5 Tokens to Write a Symphony
50646662.title_zh: 花費 35 億個 Opus 5.5 Token 來譜寫交響樂
50646662.summary_zh: 作者透過大約 35 億個 Token 的反覆修正，讓 Claude Opus 5.5 獨立完成了一首四樂章、長達 25 分鐘的完整交響樂。過程中採用了「演員-評論家迴圈（actor-critic loop）」機制，讓不同執行緒互相審查並改善樂譜與錄音。
50646662.summary_en: The author had Claude Opus 5.5 independently compose a four-movement, 25-minute full symphony through roughly 3.5 billion tokens of iterative refinement. An actor-critic loop mechanism was employed during the process, allowing different threads to review and improve the score and recording.

50608175.title: Can a TV be too large? An investigation
50608175.title_zh: 電視有可能買太大嗎？一場實際調查
50608175.summary_zh: 作者為了追求更好的畫質而將智慧型電視升級為 65 幾吋的 OLED 機型，卻在觀看時意外引發了暈眩與輕微頭痛。文章探討了這種現象在更換大尺寸螢幕的新手之間其實相當常見，並分析了可能的原因與人類眼睛的適應過程。
50608175.summary_en: The author upgraded their smart TV to a 65-inch OLED model in pursuit of better picture quality, but unexpectedly experienced motion sickness and mild headaches while watching. The article explores how this phenomenon is quite common among new large-screen adopters, analyzing potential causes and the human eye's adaptation process.

50611593.title: Show HN: An agent skill that optimizes code with falsifiable hypotheses
50611593.title_zh: 展示 HN：透過可證偽假設來優化程式碼的智慧代理技能
50611593.summary_zh: 這是一項專為 Claude Code 與 Codex 設計的演算法工程技能，能讓自主代理在每次實驗前先提出可證偽的假設。代理會在每次修改後檢查正確性，產出易於審查的修補檔，並自動記錄優化知識庫。
50611593.summary_en: This is an algorithmic engineering skill designed for Claude Code and Codex, allowing autonomous agents to propose falsifiable hypotheses before every experiment. The agent checks correctness after every change, produces reviewable patches, and automatically logs to an optimization knowledge base.

50624684.title: Show HN: Rchive – Every drive I've owned since the 90s, searchable in one window
50624684.title_zh: Show HN：Rchive – 讓我自 90 年代以來擁有過的每個硬碟，都能在同一個視窗中搜尋
50624684.summary_zh: 這是一套跨平台的桌面應用程式，能將多個實體硬碟與備份資料的檔案名稱、中繼資料及預覽圖建立索引。即使硬碟已經拔除並收納起來，使用者依然能在同一個介面中同時搜尋所有來源的檔案。它還提供檔案整理、智慧分類與具備斷點續傳功能的檔案複製工具。
50624684.summary_en: This is a cross-platform desktop application that indexes file names, metadata, and previews from multiple physical drives and backups. Users can search files across all sources within a single interface, even when the drives are unplugged and stored away. It also provides file organization, smart categorization, and file-copying tools with resume capabilities.

50648050.title: Much shorter version of GRH Lean verification from Anthropic
50648050.title_zh: Anthropic 推出的黎曼假設 Lean 驗證精簡版
50648050.summary_zh: 這是 Anthropic 團隊與 Claude 合作產出、基於 Mathlib 建構的黎曼假設與廣義黎曼假設 Lean 4 證明精簡儲存庫。該專案大幅縮減了程式碼行數，並透過機器檢查完成驗證，不過尚未經過數學家完整審閱。
50648050.summary_en: This repository features a shortened version of the Lean 4 proof for the Riemann Hypothesis and Generalized Riemann Hypothesis, built on Mathlib by Anthropic and Claude. The project significantly reduces the line count and has passed machine checks, though it has not yet been fully reviewed by mathematicians.

50647673.title: The New York Times tells photographers not to use the latest Photoshop
50647673.title_zh: 紐約時報要求攝影師避免使用最新版本的 Photoshop
50647673.summary_zh: 紐約時報針對最新版本的 Adobe Photoshop 發出指引，建議攝影師在工作流程中暫勿採用。此舉推測與該版本的特定功能或人工智慧政策有關。（無法取得原文內容，僅依標題判斷）
50647673.summary_en: The New York Times has issued guidance advising photographers against using the latest version of Adobe Photoshop in their workflows. This move is presumably related to specific features or artificial intelligence policies in the release. (Content unavailable, judged by title only)

50647161.title: Nfs2root: A 12-year-old pre-auth remote root in the Linux kernel's NFS server
50647161.title_zh: Nfs2root：Linux 核心 NFS 伺服器中存在 12 年之久的未驗證遠端 root 漏洞
50647161.summary_zh: 安全研究人員在 Linux 核心的網路檔案系統（NFS）伺服器中發現了一個存在長達 12 年的堆積緩衝區溢位漏洞（CVE-2026-99362）。遠端攻擊者無需登入即可利用此漏洞觸發記憶體損壞，進而在目標主機上取得 root 權限的命令列介面。
50647161.summary_en: Security researchers have discovered a 12-year-old heap overflow vulnerability (CVE-2026-99362) in the Linux kernel's Network File System server. Remote attackers can exploit this flaw without authentication to trigger memory corruption and ultimately gain a root shell on the target host.

50647181.title: Slow Ubuntu security response times
50647181.title_zh: Ubuntu 安全修復回應速度緩慢
50647181.summary_zh: 獨立安全研究人員指出，Ubuntu 近期對 Linux 核心重大安全漏洞（例如 NoisyTCP 與虛擬化逃逸漏洞）的修復速度過於緩慢，往往在漏洞細節公開數週後仍未釋出修復程式碼。這可能與 Ubuntu 長期將安全性修復回溯移植（backport）至舊版核心的策略有關。
50647181.summary_en: An independent security researcher points out that Ubuntu's recent response time in patching critical Linux kernel security flaws, such as NoisyTCP and virtualization escape bugs, has been concerningly slow, often leaving fixes unpublished weeks after disclosure. This sluggishness is likely tied to Ubuntu's strategy of backporting patches to older kernel versions.

50648035.title: Defang Security Incident
50648035.title_zh: Defang 雲端部署平台安全事件
50648035.summary_zh: Defang 部署建置系統遭到攻擊者入侵，其執行憑證與主要資料庫遭到複製外洩。攻擊者透過具有過多權限的測試用 GitHub App 推送帶有惡意標籤的提交，進而存取生產環境憑證；官方已全面更換憑證並呼籲受影響使用者檢查雲端帳戶與儲存庫設定。
50648035.summary_en: Defang's deployment build system suffered a security breach where its execution credentials and main database were copied and exfiltrated. The attacker exploited an over-privileged testing GitHub App to push a tagged commit, gaining access to production credentials; the company has since replaced the credentials and urged affected users to inspect their cloud accounts and repository settings.

50647158.title: 72-Hour Fasting Can Reset Your Immune System, USC Study Shows
50647158.title_zh: 南加州大學研究顯示 72 小時斷食可重置免疫系統？
50647158.summary_zh: 南加州大學主導的一項研究探討了長時間斷食與重新餵食如何影響造血幹細胞，主要對象為小鼠及接受化療的癌症患者初步觀察。科學界指出，雖然這項機制與造血系統再生有關，但不能直接簡化為單次 72 小時斷食就能完全重置健康成人的整個免疫系統。
50647158.summary_en: A USC-led study investigated how prolonged fasting and refeeding affect blood-forming stem cells, based primarily on mice and preliminary observations of chemotherapy patients. Researchers note that while this mechanism relates to hematopoietic regeneration, it should not be oversimplified as a single 72-hour fast completely resetting the entire immune system in healthy adults.

50623028.title: A fast CAS with a focus on resolution of singularities
50623028.title_zh: 專注於奇異點消解的高效電腦代數系統
50623028.summary_zh: Atlas 是一個能夠對有理數域上的多項式環進行精確計算、研究有理點上代數簇並消解超曲面奇異點的電腦代數系統（CAS）。使用者可以透過互動式提示字元、指令列、腳本或 HTTP 介面操作，並搭配「奇異點消解動物園（Resolution Zoo）」資料集來瀏覽豐富的計算範例。
50623028.summary_en: Atlas is a computer algebra system that performs exact computations with polynomial rings over the rationals, studies varieties at rational points, and resolves hypersurface singularities. Users can interact with it via an interactive prompt, command line, scripts, or HTTP interface, while exploring computed examples using the Resolution Zoo dataset.

50619073.title: The undocumented 249-file limit for Googlebot rendering
50619073.title_zh: Googlebot 渲染頁面未公開的 249 個檔案限制
50619073.summary_zh: Googlebot 在渲染網頁時，每個頁面最多僅會載入 249 個檔案資源，超過此數量的第 250 個及之後的檔案將不會被請求。這項未在官方文件中說明的限制可能導致網頁核心 JavaScript 指令碼無法載入，進而使 Google 渲染出空白頁面，但 Google 搜尋控制台（Search Console）卻仍顯示綠色通過勾選。
50619073.summary_en: Googlebot loads at most 249 file resources per page during rendering, and anything from the 250th file onward is never requested. This undocumented limit can cause critical JavaScript files to be dropped, resulting in Google rendering an empty page while Google Search Console confusingly still shows a green passing check.
